name: Tempester n°49: « Mixer » (Pads + Sounds) opens the Mixer after the compressor pages
explanation: Tempester n°49: « Mixer » (Pads + Sounds) opens the Mixer, not the compressor pages (Main 1.5.0.2). Before: [routine] records every screen 0x12-0x17 it enters in ctx+0x137, « last screen of the mixer group » (0x12 Mixer, 0x13 Mixer Delay, 0x14, 0x15 Compression / Distortion, 0x16 compressor envelope, 0x17). Pads + Sounds held together (keys 0x1C / 0x1D, either order, [routine]) open ctx+0x137. After Shift + Compression (the compressor envelope page, [routine]) or the Compression / Distortion page, « Mixer » reopened that page. Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §11. After: in the two Pads + Sounds branches only, 0x15 and 0x16 read from ctx+0x137 open the Mixer (0x12); 0x12, 0x13, 0x14, 0x17 open as before. The record itself is unchanged: the other readers of ctx+0x137 ([routine]'s caller at l. 15077, the return of l. 19211 after a temporary screen) still go back to the compressor page they left, as before. Context: main loop (UI). No RAM. Free flash 0x9D07A840-0x9D07A86F (12 words), 3 words in place; [address] (the old delay slot) is no longer reached.

last screen of the mixer group
